patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography and video are used as section backgrounds and hero elements, often with elegant text overlays.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant serif font for brand identity and major headings with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A refined palette of deep neutrals (white, light beige, dark grey) accented by rich, jewel-toned teal and subtle gold/bronze highlights, conveying luxury.
The hero background image/video exhibits a subtle parallax effect on scroll, while the top utility bar and main navigation become sticky and slightly condense after initial scroll.
Product categories are presented in a flexible grid layout, interspersed with editorial-style full-bleed image sections that act as content breaks or thematic introductions.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a dark overlay to ensure text legibility, and the video content subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls.

A multi-level sticky header system is implemented: an initial utility bar and the main navigation both become fixed at the top of the viewport after scrolling, with the utility bar potentially shrinking or transforming.
Content sections are revealed using a combination of fade-in and subtle slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, engaging scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (~3-4x body) for main titles, with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels, creating a clear hierarchy with significant size differences.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — particularly in hero and section breaks, creating a sense of luxury, while product grids are more compact but still well-spaced.

standout: The site distinguishes itself through its seamless integration of high-end, full-bleed photography and video with a sophisticated, editorial layout. The elegant serif typography for brand identity, combined with a clean sans-serif for content, creates a distinctive luxury feel that elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce template.
